qti-choice-interaction.qti-prompt: Maya volunteered to trace her family tree and found the records knotted: three certificates were mislabeled, and two archives had filed her great-grandfather under different spellings of his name. But each error, once spotted, pointed straight to the next fix. Working from the outside in, she unpicked the knots one at a time, every session closing more questions than it opened, and by the end of the week the tree was finished. What had Maya's research turned out to be?
qti-choice-interaction.qti-simple-choice: A muddle too small to cost her an evening
A tangle she could unpick one knot at a time
A morass of mislabeled and conflicting records
A nightmare that made the project unbearable

qti-content-body.p: Yes. Knotted records, but each knot could be unpicked from the outside, one at a time, and every session left fewer open questions than the last. A confused mess you can work through strand by strand is a tangle.

Not quite. The records were genuinely knotted, but look at the direction of Maya's progress: each error pointed to its own fix, every session closed questions, and the whole tree was done in a week. Pick the answer for a mess that yields to steady unpicking.

A muddle is a small mix-up — a double-booked meeting — that an afternoon can straighten out. Maya's records took a full week of steady, methodical work across two archives; this was a real knot, not a trivial slip. Find the answer sized to a mess you unpick knot by knot.

A morass swallows effort: you sink into it, and working harder only pulls you deeper. Maya's week went the opposite way. Each error pointed straight to its fix, every session closed more questions than it opened, and the tree got finished. Records that yield to patient unpicking from the outside are a tangle, not a morass.

People reach for nightmare when a situation stops feeling merely tangled and starts feeling unbearable. Nothing here is unbearable — Maya makes steady, satisfying progress all week and finishes on schedule. Name the mess that steady work can untie.
